name: NESCAC Cross Country Championships
headline: NESCAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Williams won the women’s title with 36 points, four ahead of host Middlebury (40), with Tufts third (94). Middlebury’s Audrey MacLean won the 6K in 20:54.4, ahead of teammate Annelise Jensen (21:14.1) and Williams’ Kate Tuttle (21:19.5). Amherst took the men’s title by one point, 66 to Williams’ 67, with Tufts third (70), Wesleyan fourth (83) and Middlebury fifth (116); Wesleyan’s Dylan Cote won the 8K in 24:31.1.
